name: Mount Lofty Ranges
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A South Australian zone containing Adelaide Hills, Adelaide Plains and Clare Valley. South Australia as a whole crushes about half of Australia's wine grapes.
